title: RJ Airplane Tracker Widget
desc: A native Windows desktop widget & live geofenced radar tracking airborne aircraft in real-time around Mumbai International Airport (BOM) using the OpenSky Network API. Built for my friend Rohan Jain who lives next to the runway and wanted instant alerts when planes fly overhead.

title: Faulty Scientific Calculator
desc: A satirical, maliciously compliant simulation of the infamous GATE / TCS iON on-screen exam calculator with broken mouse click resistance, keypad musical chairs, multilingual script roulette, and absurd calculus outputs.

title: Wall Jump Maze Runner
desc: Pac-Man-inspired interactive portfolio mini game built in Canvas, with pellet collection, ghost collision, and a timed wall-jump ability.

title: Kaggle ML Competitions Suite
desc: 6 Kaggle competition submissions across two MLP course terms — covering flight price prediction, customer churn classification, restaurant review rating prediction, cinema audience forecasting, and more. Techniques include gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), feature engineering, NLP pipelines, and ensemble methods.

links.label: KA1 — Flight Price Prediction
links.desc: Regression on flight ticket data using XGBoost with feature engineering on routes, stops, and departure time.

links.label: KA2 — Customer Churn
links.desc: Binary classification predicting bank customer exit using gradient boosting and class-imbalance handling.

links.label: KA3 — Review Rating Prediction
links.desc: NLP pipeline predicting eatery ratings from customer reviews using TF-IDF and ensemble models.

links.label: Cinema Audience Forecasting
links.desc: Time-series forecasting of cinema footfall using lag features, rolling statistics, and LightGBM.

links.label: T3 KA1
links.desc: Term 3 competition — structured data classification with hyperparameter-tuned tree ensembles.

links.label: T3 KA2
links.desc: Term 3 competition — multi-class prediction with stacked generalization and feature selection.

links.label: T3 KA3
links.desc: Term 3 competition — regression task with advanced feature engineering and cross-validation.

title: MCA Agent — Agentic AI RAG
desc: An experimental Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agent built to explore agentic AI patterns — document ingestion, vector search, and LLM-powered Q&A. Work-in-progress.

links.label: GitHub Repository
links.desc: Ingests documents into a vector store, retrieves relevant chunks, and generates LLM answers with source citations.

title: Trekking Management App (MAD-1)
desc: Full-stack web application for managing trekking expeditions — staff payouts, expense tracking, expedition bookings, debrief reports, and SQLite-backed data persistence. Built and evaluated under strict architecture standards for IIT Madras MAD-1 course.

title: Energy Equities MI Reporting
desc: Dataset generation, exception monitoring, and MI-style reporting for 10 NSE energy companies.

title: Commodity-Equity Linkages
desc: Global commodities vs Nifty 50 with timing, causality, rolling betas, and a ranked indicator dashboard. Embedded full report.

title: IITM BDM Capstone
desc: Client segmentation and retention analysis for Raftaar. Proposal, midterm, final, and presentation embedded on one page.

title: DatabaseStudy — Chaos ERP Database
desc: Open-source chaos-simulated enterprise ERP database generator. 28 interconnected tables spanning Finance, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Logistics, and HR — loaded with dirty nulls, embedded JSON payloads, mixed date formats, orphan foreign keys, and ledger imbalances. Fully randomized on every run.
